2025 California Building Code with local
amendments. In compliance with state
law, the California Building Standards
Code is revised and updated every three
years with the next edition going into
effect on January 1st, 2026.
State law specifies the procedure by
which local cities may amend and adopt
the California Building Code, which
includes first setting first the setting
of the public hearing, second the
holding of the public hearing, and
lastly the second reading and formal
adoption of the ordinance. This process
generally takes place in December and
was last completed in 2022.
However, recent legislative changes have
significantly impacted the ability of
local jurisdictions to include local
amendments within their residential
building codes. Specifically, Assembly
Bill 130, formerly known as AB306,
was recently enacted into law and
prohibits local jurisdictions from
adopting or changing residential
building standards for a six-year period
beginning October 1st, 2025 through June
Therefore, any local amendments must be
adopted prior to October 1st, 2025.
Torrance generally adopts local
amendments that are related to unique
geological, topographical, and climatic
conditions to increase public safety
that are not adequately adequate
adequately covered by the California
Building Standards Code. Regarding the
2025 California building standard code,
the most notable changes focus on energy
efficient is energy efficiency, seismic
safety, high-rise construction with a
push towards electrification and
stricter requirements for wildfire prone
areas. The code also updates
accessibility standards and inspection
certification processes
by setting the public hearing date of
September 9th and adopting both an
urgency ordinance and a regular
ordinance. Staff is confident that the
city will meet the October 1 deadline
set by AB130.

ordinance would be upon while the
